tests.name: a11y-focus-entry
tests.setup: const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.focus(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (c.dataset.focusedId === '') throw new Error('Focus-on-entry failed: no focusedId after focus'); if (c.dataset.hasFocus !== 'true') throw new Error('hasFocus not set');

tests.name: a11y-blur-clear
tests.setup: const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.focus(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const idBefore = c.dataset.focusedId; c.blur(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); if (c.dataset.focusedId !== '') throw new Error('Blur-clear failed: focusedId should be empty after blur in clear mode, got ' + c.dataset.focusedId); if (c.dataset.hasFocus !== 'false') throw new Error('hasFocus should be false after blur');

tests.name: a11y-blur-preserve
tests.setup: const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); document.querySelector('[data-action=toggle-blur-mode]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); c.focus(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const idBefore = c.dataset.focusedId; c.blur(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); if (c.dataset.focusedId !== idBefore) throw new Error('Blur-preserve failed: focusedId changed from ' + idBefore + ' to ' + c.dataset.focusedId); if (c.dataset.hasFocus !== 'false') throw new Error('hasFocus should be false after blur');

tests.name: a11y-blur-preserve-refocus
tests.setup: const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); document.querySelector('[data-action=toggle-blur-mode]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); c.focus(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'ArrowRight', bubbles: true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const idBefore = c.dataset.focusedId; c.blur(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); c.focus(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); if (c.dataset.focusedId !== idBefore) throw new Error('Re-focus should restore same focusedId, got ' + c.dataset.focusedId + ' expected ' + idBefore); if (c.dataset.hasFocus !== 'true') throw new Error('hasFocus should be true after re-focus');

tests.name: a11y-destroy-nav
tests.setup: document.querySelector('[data-action=destroy-nav]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (c.dataset.navDestroyed !== 'true') throw new Error('navDestroyed not set'); if (c.hasAttribute('tabindex')) throw new Error('tabindex should be removed after destroy'); if (document.querySelector('[aria-live]')) throw new Error('Live region should be removed after destroy');
